title: Misleading rank-3 equivariant-basis caching across a structure-relaxation trajectory
authoring_note: SciML equivariant-head counterexample. The fixture is a small structure-relaxation trajectory where positions change every step. A tempting cache of edge vectors / rank-3 basis violates rank-3 equivariance and produces stale results; the correct action is to recompute every step (do_not_apply semantics). Plain torch only. The reference abstention patch is a no-op plus an evidence comment.
author: batch-SciML-A prototype agent
